name: reminders
description: Due-date reminders with optional recurrence. Delivered to your phone via the ntfy package when it's installed; otherwise they queue in the app.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 015_reminders.sql, hot-loads the app).
Add a reminder: POST /api/reminders/reminders with {"text": "...", "due_at": "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"} (optionally "recurrence": "daily"|"weekly").
Install the ntfy package to get reminders pushed to your phone; without it they are still tracked and listed.
